cases.code:
def select(model):
    bedroom_items = elements_in_space(model, "2 - Bedroom")
    furniture = by_type(bedroom_items, "IfcFurniture")
    bed = by_name(furniture, "bed")
    desk = by_name(furniture, "desk")
    return bed + desk

def modify(model, targets):
    living_room = next(s for s in model.by_type("IfcSpace") if s.Name == "1 - Living room")
    ifcopenshell.api.run("spatial.assign_container", model, products=targets, relating_structure=living_room)
